item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-132165 - Drupal Core
item.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-24)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-109618 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code e… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code ex… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.description: InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unbounded resource allocation vulnerability in the DistServe proxy /distserve/connection_warmup endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory. While a prefill/decode connection is pending, for example after registering a slow node via /nodes/add, repeated warmup requests spawn unbounded wait_for_conn() tasks and sockets until the proxy process is…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.3] CVE-2026-137543
item.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by abusing the unvalidated ai_ollama_base_url setting. Once a settings.edit user points the Ollama base URL internally, any post.create user can call /admin/ai/generate-seo with provider=ollama to fetch internal data reflected in SEO fields.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.7] CVE-2026-137497
item.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.7] CVE-2026-137469
item.description: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.11 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AI agent chat panel, which renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without HTML sanitisation. Attackers influencing model replies via indirect prompt injection or a configured model endpoint can inject event-handler markup, executing OS commands through Node.js integration in desktop local-kernel mode.

item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.1] CVE-2026-137463
item.description: HKUDS nanobot from 0.1.4 before 0.4.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the OpenAI Codex provider that retries authenticated requests without TLS certificate or hostname verification. Attackers able to intercept the connection can trigger a certificate failure and impersonate the endpoint to steal bearer tokens, read request contents, or alter responses.

item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-137567
item.description: llama.cpp b11450 before b12658 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ggml RPC server that allows unauthenticated attackers to write to arbitrary heap addresses via zero-element destination tensors. Attackers can learn buffer bases with BUFFER_GET_BASE, then send RPC_CMD_COPY_TENSOR with a destination pointer below the buffer base to crash the server or execute code.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.1] CVE-2026-131688
item.description: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for attackers (with access to a valid MCP bearer token) to escalate privileges to the token owner's Administrator role…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.2] CVE-2026-131589

The vulnerability exists because the `add_image_from_url()` function applies the `get_allowed_mime_types()` extension allow-list only on the…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.3] CVE-2026-137308
item.description: markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass URL validation by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Attackers can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown through prompt injection to fetch loopback services, internal hosts, and cloud metadata endpoints.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2026-137056
item.description: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privile…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.7] CVE-2026-137057
item.description: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the proce…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.7] CVE-2026-136630
item.description: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.1] CVE-2026-136620
item.description: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.1] CVE-2026-136185
item.description: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2026-7700 - pip:langflow
item.description: Langflow: Prompt injection in Langflow Smart Transform can lead to code execution

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.3] CVE-2026-134827
item.description: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-42010 - Gnu gnutls, Redhat ai inference server
item.description: A flaw was found in gnutls. Servers configured with RSA-PSK (Rivest–Shamir–Adleman – Pre-Shared Key) wrongfully matched usernames containing a NUL character with truncated usernames. A remote attacker could exploit this by sending a specially crafted username, leading to an authentication bypass. This vulnerability allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access by circumventing the authentication process.

This vulnerability was patched in versions 1.28.1 and 2.0.0a2. Customers need to redeploy the upgraded ADK to their produ…

item.title: [EXPLOITED | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2023-25914 - Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
item.description: Due to improper restriction, authenticated attackers could retrieve and read system files of the underlying server through the XML interface. The information that can be read can lead to a full system compromise. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-25)

item.title: [EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.9] CVE-2023-25915 - Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
item.description: Due to improper input validation, an authenticated remote attacker could execute arbitrary commands on the target system. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-25)

item.title: [EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-133303 - Mitel MiCollab
item.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-25)

item.title: [EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 10.0] CVE-2026-133323 - Mitel MiCollab
item.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-25)

item.description: In Apache Airflow versions 2.2.4 through 2.3.3, the `database` webserver session backend was susceptible to session fixation.

item.description: The variable import endpoint was not protected by authentication in Airflow >=2.0.0, =2.0.0, <2.1.3.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2020-11981 - Apache airflow
item.description: An issue was found in Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below. When using CeleryExecutor, if an attacker can connect to the broker (Redis, RabbitMQ) directly, it is possible to inject commands, resulting in the celery worker running arbitrary commands.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2020-11982 - Apache airflow
item.description: An issue was found in Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below. When using CeleryExecutor, if an attack can connect to the broker (Redis, RabbitMQ) directly, it was possible to insert a malicious payload directly to the broker which could lead to a deserialization attack (and thus remote code execution) on the Worker.

item.title: [EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2020-13927 - Apache Airflow's Experimental API
item.description: The previous default setting for Airflow's Experimental API was to allow all API requests without authentication, but this poses security risks to users who miss this fact. From Airflow 1.10.11 the default has been changed to deny all requests by default and is documented at https://airflow.apache.org/docs/1.10.11/security.html#api-authentication. Note this change fixes it for new installs but existing users need to… (CISA KEV added 2022-01-18)

item.description: An issue was found in Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below. A remote code/command injection vulnerability was discovered in one of the example DAGs shipped with Airflow which would allow any authenticated user to run arbitrary commands as the user running airflow worker/scheduler (depending on the executor in use). If you already have examples disabled by setting load_examples=False in the config then you are n… (CISA KEV added 2022-01-18)

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2017-17836 - Apache airflow
item.description: In Apache Airflow 1.8.2 and earlier, an experimental Airflow feature displayed authenticated cookies, as well as passwords to databases used by Airflow. An attacker who has limited access to airflow, whether it be via XSS or by leaving a machine unlocked can exfiltrate all credentials from the system.

item.description: Smart Portal developed by Direk Tech has a Missing Authorization vulnerability. Authenticated remote attackers can add a specified account to the Active Directory Domain Admins group, thereby obtaining domain administrator privileges.

item.description: A path traversal vulnerability was identified in Samba when processing client pipe names connecting to Unix domain sockets within a private directory. Samba typically uses this mechanism to connect SMB clients to remote procedure call (RPC) services like SAMR LSA or SPOOLSS, which Samba initiates on demand. item.title: [CRITICAL 9.1] CVE-2023-6394 - Quarkus quarkus, Redhat build of quarkus
item.description: A flaw was found in Quarkus. This issue occurs when receiving a request over websocket with no role-based permission specified on the GraphQL operation, Quarkus processes the request without authentication despite the endpoint being secured. This can allow an attacker to access information and functionality outside of normal granted API permissions.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-137550
item.description: Frappe Framework before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Document.update() that fails to validate whether the caller is permitted to submit or modify the target document. Attackers can invoke document update operations to submit or alter documents they are not authorized to change.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-137547
item.description: Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 returns database connection errors containing a temporary AWS IAM database password in API key middleware responses. During database connection failures, unauthenticated attackers can send a well-formed but invalid API key to obtain the password and access the PostgreSQL database for 15 minutes.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.4] CVE-2026-137544
item.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in module.json providers and composer.json psr-4 namespace parsing that derives destination folder names without excluding traversal characters. Attackers with module.create permission can upload a crafted module ZIP to write PHP files into the public directory, achieving unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-137536
item.description: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authentication bypass in its server OAuth SSO sign-in module, which resolves Google and Git SSO logins solely by the provider-asserted email without checking email_verified or binding the SSO subject. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a trusted-issuer token carrying a victim's unverified email to the SSO callback to obtain the victim's session, including admin accounts.

item.title: [CRITICAL 10.0] CVE-2026-137498
item.description: Budibase Server from 3.39.18 before 4.0.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to erase MongoDB query filters by supplying __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries. Attackers can send a single request to the query execution endpoint, reducing the filter to {} to read, update, or delete every document in the collection.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-137499
item.description: Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.9] CVE-2026-137494
item.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.0] CVE-2026-137471
item.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability where WebDAV sync error formatting skips HTML escaping for certain malformed-response errors, passing raw markup to the Electron notification renderer. item.title: [CRITICAL 9.1] CVE-2026-137465
item.description: Parse Server 3.10.0 before 8.6.123 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.4 contains an authentication bypass in the Google Play Games authentication adapter, which does not verify that the supplied player ID belongs to the presented access token. Attackers can sign in with their own Google Play Games credential while claiming another user's player ID to take over that account or link that player ID to their own account.

item.description: The WordPress File Upload plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Deletion in versions up to, and including, 5.3.1 via the 'wfu_ajax_action_handshake' and 'wfu_ajax_action_send_email_notification' AJAX Actions.
